plain_english_policy: This bill prohibits new landfills and junk yards from being built within one mile of the Chattahoochee River if they are located outside city limits.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would restrict waste disposal infrastructure development near a specific waterway to protect environmental quality in that area. It specifically bans construction permits for new landfills (including solid, hazardous, and industrial types) or junk yards within the one-mile buffer zone outside municipal boundaries.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representatives Vance, Thigpen, Boothe, Harper, Martin, Shiver, Hill, Gipson and Clouse affirmatively advanced this environmental protection measure.
evidence_quotes: This bill would prohibit the establishment of a new landfill or junk yard outside of the corporate limits of any municipality within one mile of the Chattahoochee River.
